## Result and scope

Refs #193

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/193#issuecomment-6863375448, session `ADB991-claude-20261113-5502`
- Unit IDs or other outputs: YM-000026, package C14 (#55). Report-only: two new files under `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C14/review/ADB991-claude-20261113-5502/` (README, validation). No manuscript, author-record, ledger, Lean or shared file is edited.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: ADB991 (account). Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission. ADB991 authored no C14 chapter and neither PR #216 commit. The same account wrote review #230, whose points this delta answers.

This is the renewed different-account review requested in https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/193#issuecomment-6862943660. It covers only the PR #216 author follow-up `44df7abe..4c141ec8`: two passages in `trace-calibration-producer.tex`, one in `actual-stress-annulus.tex`, the updated author hash manifest and the new author records.

**Outcome: M1, M2, O1 and O2 of #230 are all addressed. No new defect; no change required.**

- **M1.** The text now says the firesky display assumes the bound on an $F$-late set, which is stronger and gives the ultrafilter-set bound because the ultrafilter refines the fused filter of $F$. The implication goes the right way, and the missing comma is restored.
- **M2.** "Proposed construction" now names `prop:ex-lattice-actual-shell-node`. This is a backward reference: `actual-stress-shell-nodes` is input just before `actual-stress-annulus`. The conditional status is kept ("Under its stated inputs").
- **O1.** The gallery theorem now assumes the one-stage selection for every positive null sequence, matching its conclusion and the ledger. Checked textually against `YM.MergeProof.East.boatsSky` and `wakesSky`, which quantify over an arbitrary positive `s` with `Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 0)`.
- **O2.** "Are supplied by the inputs" does not claim the inputs are proved.

Optional: **N1**, a wording point. The "when the ultrafilter refines …" clause could point to the extraction paragraph where that refinement is fixed.

Out of scope, for integration: **N2**. Eight displays in `manuscript/existence/` carry a manual `\tag{1}`, so cross-chapter `\eqref`s to them all render as "(1)". Page 839 shows this for `eq:ex-lattice-firesky-lift-bound`. The issue predates this delta.
